findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "execute_procurement_order" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
detail: Server "mcp-endpoint.php" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: onboard_partner, execute_procurement_order · Private data: calculate_roi, execute_procurement_order, track_order_status · Public sink: execute_procurement_order · Destructive: execute_procurement_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: onboard_partner, execute_procurement_order · Private data: calculate_roi, execute_procurement_order, track_order_status · Public sink: execute_procurement_order · Destructive: execute_procurement_order

remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "query_hardware_specs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
